title: Valar Atomics mission
description: On a white band: a heading and two short paragraphs on the left, and on the right a big plate-shaped link (chamfered corners, a raised tab on top, a notch underneath) outlined by a grey hairline with a mono caps label in its centre. Hovering the plate lights it with a soft gold glow.
notes: the plate shape is a clip-path; its glow uses the theme's --glow (gold here)
`texture` fills the plate (the original's is a fine lattice image); empty it stays plain
